test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five friends are sitting on a bench facing North and South alternately. R is sitting at the left corner and facing North, and T is second to the right of R. If P is third to the left of Q, who is facing North. then what is the sitting position of S?

options.text: Facing South and right of T
Facing North and right of Q
Facing North and Right of T
Facing South and left of P

solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Five friends are sitting on a bench facing North and South

1) R is sitting at the left corner and facing North.

2) Five friends are sitting on a bench facing North and South **alternately**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fddf9423c4d0f5cc2c9c59e171ec79fdc8fe44126664458caa14e1bad0882d6.png] 

3) T is second to the right of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8a0731de84abfa33deafae1b8f77fef1170653b98d9eeaf9dc4e5d14c07923b.png] 

4) If P is third to the left of **__Q, who is__** facing North.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28f0c78fa2fb702a8b455020021c2b392a21952e945788034b454ab67fb7f8d3.png] 

5) Position of five friend with there direction facing is :

Case (i):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/519b48370a1968c7aeed7f7995ee051c5dfb34cee67f3d4f9140a83761440692.png] 

∴ Here, 'S' is facing South and right of T.

Hence. the correct answer is **"Facing South and right of T".**
